topic: Fuel-free helpers and action-based Memory upgrades
currentUserGoal: Make every helper a cooldown-driven auto-clicker with no resource inputs, and change every related Memory so it improves speed, touches, healing, or opening charge instead of fuel, storage, or starter stock.
workCompleted: Removed all production-resource inputs from every purchasable helper mode: Tiny Sprinkler, Field Mouse, Bee Hive, Chicken Patrol, Earthworm Crew, Ancient Roots, Sheep Loop, and Meadow Rabbit.
Made every helper output overflow-safe so full resource buffers cannot pause helper cycles, automated touches, or healing.
Kept natural field conversions as passive background ecology; helpers never consume their resources.
Changed Field Mouse Damp Furrows into a free Tiny Sprinkler synergy that adds Growth and Care without consuming Moisture.
Removed Field Mouse Seed caches, Bee Hive Flower reserves, starvation teaching states, input discounts, helper storage scaling, and starting-resource grants.
Repurposed existing rank save slots without invalidating saves: throughput is Speed, storage is Reach, efficiency is Care, and startingStock is Momentum.
Added 15% more automated touches per Reach rank, 12% more healing per Care rank, and 20% opening-cycle charge per Momentum rank.
Preserved Tiny Sprinkler's bespoke Dew Cistern afterglow and Fine Mist area-touch upgrades.
Renamed and rewrote relevant Memory nodes so their names and descriptions describe action speed, reach, healing, and opening momentum rather than stored supplies.
Rewrote Living Ledger, semantic browser guidance, chapter copy, purchase feedback, mode copy, and the durable ecosystem design document for the clicker-to-auto-clicker loop.
Returned the local playtest save to a clean Run 1 after browser stress verification.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, Knip, 158 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Focused ecosystem system, Memory Web, and save tests passed: 87 tests across 3 files.
Deterministic tests verify every helper recipe has no inputs, every helper output allows overflow, and helpers still cycle and award touches with empty resources and full output buffers.

Desktop 1280x720 browser stress check used a 100x100 field and twelve of every helper: automation sustained about 5,597 touches/s, resource buffers reached FULL without stopping Tiny Sprinkler, fullFieldScans stayed at zero, sampled FPS held at 144 with zero frame spikes, and browser logs had no warnings or errors.

Phone-layout 390x844 browser stress check retained the 100x100 field and all helper tiers: automation sustained about 5,628 touches/s, resource buffers remained full while cycles advanced, fullFieldScans stayed at zero, sampled FPS held at 144 with zero frame spikes, and browser logs had no warnings or errors.
The Memory Web semantic controls expose the new names including Scamper Routes, First Scamper, Wider Swarm, Scratch Pattern, Branching Burrows, Root Network, Wider Circuit, and Spring Step.
knownIssues: The natural field conversion graph still consumes intermediate resources as passive background ecology, but no purchasable helper uses those resources as fuel.
Ecosystem Works and the Living Ledger still display the thematic resource chain; a later simplification pass may be useful if those counters distract from the clicker and auto-clicker loop.
The stronger fuel-free automation curve needs hands-on balance testing from Run 2 onward.
The debug panel overlays content on a 390x844 viewport; this remains confined to the debugPanel route.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and was not modified.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test Run 2 through the first Field Mouse and compare how quickly manual clicking gives way to automation.
Tune helper purchase costs, base cooldowns, Reach, and Care only from observed run pacing.
Decide whether the passive resource counters and Ecosystem Works graph still add useful flavor or should be simplified further.
Push, deploy, and synchronize with the Mac only when requested.
doNotRevert: Do not restore any production-resource input to a purchasable helper recipe.
Do not let empty or full resource buffers pause helper automated touches.
Do not restore Seed caches, Flower reserves, helper starvation states, input discounts, helper storage ranks, or starting-resource grants.
Do not rename the internal permanent rank save keys without a migration; their player-facing meanings have intentionally changed while preserving old saves.
Do not turn Dew Cistern or Fine Mist back into their obsolete fuel and efficiency mechanics.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
